_readme: Battery's own company pages, one fetch per URL in https://www.battery.com/company-sitemap.xml, parsed by scratch/pull-site-companies.py (re-runnable; raw HTML cached under scratch/site-raw/). Fields are the firm's own: sectors, invest_year (its INVESTED year), site_status (free text), site_location, site_stage (Early|Growth|Buyout) and the per-deal Battery Team with titles. site_stage and invest_year are scored on the calibration gate before either is trusted as a label.
